summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 18, 2026 stock exchange announcement titled Share Purchase - Long Term Incentive Plans. The company will enter forward transactions to acquire up to 6.6 million ordinary shares, roughly EUR 110 million at current prices, to hedge obligations under its long-term incentive plans, with shares intended for delivery to its employee benefit trust. Transactions will comply with EU Market Abuse Regulation. This is routine share buyback administration for compensation, not a special situation; watch for execution details and dilution or overhang effects.
